gameDescriptionHtml:
You awaken amidst a sea of scrap, without memories. Fight to survive. Explore a treacherous wasteland. Discover who you are now.

Exsys is an action-packed adventure that blends classic 90s beat-’em-up gameplay with modern Action RPG elements. Explore a stunning 3D world of scrap and danger.

Game Features

  • Free Combo system: Break free from rigid combos! Unleash devastating combos with free-flowing combat. Chain attacks and commands to create your own unique fighting style.
  • Active Skill System: Discover skills in the form of equipable items. Mix and match to tailor your combat style. Use fighting game-style commands to unleash their power. Mix, match, and order a skill with the same command to create a chain of moves that execute in order.
  • Item system: Collect and utilize a variety of items to buff your stats, debuff enemies, and unleash special attacks. Equip up to 4 items in your quick slots for easy access during combat. Combine items and skills to create a unique fighting style and survive the harsh world of scrap. Store items in the stash for your next character.
  • Your character lives only once. If your character dies, you lose everything on that character and start the new game with a new character.
